newsHighlights.title: 'Mini-breaks' poised to boost tourism
newsHighlights.summary: China's tourism market is poised for a new wave of growth as primary and junior high school students begin their autumn "mini-breaks" this month.
newsHighlights.translation: 随着中小学本月陆续开启秋季“短假”，中国旅游市场有望迎来新一轮增长。

newsHighlights.title: Guilin finds fresh ways to surprise
newsHighlights.summary: The scenic city of Guilin is rolling out creative cultural and travel experiences to keep surprising both domestic and international visitors.
newsHighlights.translation: 风景名城桂林不断推出富有创意的文化与旅游体验，持续给国内外游客带来惊喜。

newsHighlights.title: Experience drone food delivery in Shenzhen
newsHighlights.summary: Journalists from APEC member economies experienced futuristic city life in Shenzhen, from drone-delivered bubble tea to exoskeleton robots.
newsHighlights.translation: 来自亚太经合组织成员经济体的记者在深圳体验了未来城市生活：无人机送奶茶、试穿外骨骼机器人等。

newsHighlights.title: Wushu Olympics debut inspires Kenyans
newsHighlights.summary: Wushu's historic debut at the Olympic Games has inspired a growing number of young Kenyans to take up the traditional Chinese martial art.
newsHighlights.translation: 武术在奥运会上的历史性首秀，激励了越来越多肯尼亚年轻人习练这项中国传统武术。

newsHighlights.title: 9th China International Import Expo opens in Shanghai
newsHighlights.summary: The 9th China International Import Expo opened in Shanghai, drawing global businesses and cultural exhibitors to one of the world's largest trade and exchange platforms.
newsHighlights.translation: 第九届中国国际进口博览会在上海开幕，吸引全球企业和文化展商齐聚这一世界最大的贸易与交流平台之一。

quote.quote: The world is a book, and those who do not travel read only one page.
quote.author: Saint Augustine
quote.translation: 世界是一本书，不旅行的人只读了其中的一页。
quote.explanation: 这句名言强调旅行是拓宽视野、理解不同文化的重要方式。正如新闻中桂林不断推陈出新、深圳展示未来生活方式，走出去体验世界，才能真正读懂它的丰富与多元。

vocabulary.example: China's tourism market is poised for a new wave of growth this autumn.
vocabulary.translation: 今年秋天，中国旅游市场蓄势待发，即将迎来新一轮增长。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻 "'Mini-breaks' poised to boost tourism"，形容旅游市场处于增长前夜。

vocabulary.example: Short autumn breaks are expected to boost tourism across the country.
vocabulary.translation: 秋季短假有望促进全国旅游业的发展。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻标题 "'Mini-breaks' poised to boost tourism"。

vocabulary.example: Young innovators are using technology to build climate resilience in tourism destinations.
vocabulary.translation: 年轻创新者正利用技术增强旅游目的地的气候韧性。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻 "Young innovators harness tech to build climate resilience amid El Nino"。

vocabulary.definition: 利用（自然力、技术等）；驾驭
vocabulary.example: The city harnesses digital tools to offer visitors smarter travel experiences.
vocabulary.translation: 这座城市利用数字工具为游客提供更智能的旅行体验。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻 "Young innovators harness tech to build climate resilience"，意为“利用技术”。

vocabulary.example: Wushu's Olympic debut inspired many young Kenyans to learn Chinese martial arts.
vocabulary.translation: 武术的奥运首秀激励了许多肯尼亚年轻人学习中国武术。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻 "Wushu Olympics debut inspires Kenyans"。

vocabulary.example: Guilin's creative tourism projects inspire travelers to explore beyond the classic scenery.
vocabulary.translation: 桂林富有创意的旅游项目激励游客去探索经典山水之外的风景。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻 "Wushu Olympics debut inspires Kenyans"，意为“激励、鼓舞”。

vocabulary.example: Shenzhen offers innovative travel experiences such as drone food delivery.
vocabulary.translation: 深圳提供诸如无人机送餐等创新的旅行体验。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻 "Experience drone food delivery in Shenzhen" 中提到的创新型城市体验。

vocabulary.example: Guilin remains one of China's most popular travel destinations for foreign visitors.
vocabulary.translation: 桂林仍是外国游客最喜爱的中国旅游目的地之一。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻 "Guilin finds fresh ways to surprise" 中对旅游目的地的描述。

vocabulary.example: Companies from around the world exhibit their products at the Import Expo in Shanghai.
vocabulary.translation: 来自世界各地的企业在上海的进博会上展出自己的产品。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻 "9th China International Import Expo opens in Shanghai" 中的参展与展示活动。

vocabulary.example: Travelers can enjoy immersive cultural shows that bring Guilin's history to life.
vocabulary.translation: 游客可以欣赏沉浸式文化演出，让桂林的历史鲜活呈现。
vocabulary.newsContext: 关联新闻 "Guilin finds fresh ways to surprise" 中提到的新型文化体验形式。

pattern.pattern: be poised to do sth / be poised for sth（蓄势待发；即将迎来……）
pattern.example: China's tourism market is poised for a new wave of growth as students start their autumn breaks.
pattern.translation: 随着学生们开始秋季短假，中国旅游市场即将迎来新一轮增长。
pattern.usage: be poised to 后接动词原形，be poised for 后接名词，表示“准备好、即将发生”，常用于新闻报道和商务写作中描述趋势，比 be going to 更正式、更有画面感。

grammar.title: as 引导原因/时间状语从句
grammar.explanation: 在新闻英语中，as 常用来引导原因或时间状语从句，表示“由于、随着”。当 as 表示“随着”时，强调两个变化同时发生，从句常用一般现在时，主句可用一般将来时或现在时。这种结构简洁紧凑，是新闻标题和导语中的高频句式。
examples: China's tourism market is poised for a new wave of growth as students start their autumn breaks this month.
As more young Kenyans take up wushu, the traditional martial art is gaining popularity across Africa.

pronunciation.tips: 注意重音在第一个音节 /ˈtʊə/，/ʊ/ 音短促圆唇，不要读成 /tɔː/；结尾 -ism 发 /ɪzəm/，快速带过。可对比 tourist /ˈtʊərɪst/ 和 tour /tʊə(r)/ 一起练习。
examples: Guilin's tourism industry is finding fresh ways to surprise visitors.
Short breaks are expected to boost domestic tourism this season.

reading.title: Short Breaks, Big Surprises: China's Tourism Gets a Fresh Boost
reading.content: As autumn arrives, China's tourism market is poised for a new wave of growth. With primary and junior high school students starting their short "mini-breaks" this month, families are looking for destinations that offer both relaxation and discovery. Guilin, long famous for its karst mountains and the Li River, is finding fresh ways to surprise visitors with immersive cultural shows and creative travel routes. Meanwhile, tech-savvy Shenzhen gives travelers a taste of the future, from bubble tea delivered by drone to helpful exoskeleton robots. For those interested in Chinese culture, wushu's historic Olympic debut has sparked new curiosity about traditional martial arts. Whether it is a weekend getaway or a longer holiday, these experiences show that travel is about more than sightseeing — it is about connecting with people, history, and innovation.
reading.translation: 随着秋天来临，中国旅游市场蓄势待发，即将迎来新一轮增长。随着中小学本月开启“短假”，许多家庭正在寻找既能放松身心又能有所发现的目的地。素以喀斯特山峰和漓江闻名的桂林，正通过沉浸式文化演出和创意旅游线路给游客带来新的惊喜。与此同时，科技感十足的深圳让游客一窥未来：从无人机送来的奶茶到贴心的外骨骼机器人。对中国文化感兴趣的人而言，武术的历史性奥运首秀也激发了人们对传统武术的新好奇。无论是周末短途出行还是更长的假期，这些体验都表明，旅行不只是观光——更是与人、与历史、与创新的连接。
reading.sourceNote: 本文基于 China Daily 2026-11-07 报道 "'Mini-breaks' poised to boost tourism"、"Guilin finds fresh ways to surprise"、"Experience drone food delivery in Shenzhen" 及 "Wushu Olympics debut inspires Kenyans" 改写，供英语学习使用。
